name: Turf War's Gambit
author: Minty
summary: Pieces paint tiles their color, splashing onto adjacent tiles on capture. Earn $1 per 5 white tiles at the end of a game.
description: A rare money gambit that turns the board into a paint fight. When the board is set, every tile with a piece takes that piece's color. Each move paints the destination tile, and each capture also splashes the four adjacent tiles. When you win the game you earn $1 for every 5 white tiles on the board, crumbled ones included. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs alongside it.
